narrative.overview: Flownix is a restrained, dense private financial research terminal. Neutral graphite surfaces keep source evidence, timestamps and availability legible during long sessions. The observation-blue accent identifies interaction and focus; semantic status colors describe observed facts without predicting returns.
keyCharacteristics: Evidence and source freshness remain inspectable beside observations.
Flat, table-first workbench with compact typography and generous control targets.
Explicit dark and light themes; text accompanies every status.
Original flow mark, system typography and no decorative motion.

rules.name: Evidence Color
rules.body: Status color describes an observed change or availability state; it never predicts an outcome. Always retain the text label.

rules.name: Flat Workbench
rules.body: Use tonal surfaces and thin separators for structure. The active-navigation inset line is an indicator, not floating elevation.

dos: Do keep source identity, UTC observation times and availability visible.
Do use the existing semantic variables so light and dark states remain consistent.
Do preserve keyboard focus, reduced-motion support and labelled table scrolling.
Do preserve the flow mark paths, proportions and independent identity.
donts: Don't invent provider coverage, metrics, profit probabilities or live chart data.
Don't use status colors to imply returns or Binance endorsement.
Don't add decorative motion, marketing heroes or unsupported performance charts.
